results.snippet:
Shopify Inc. is a Canadian multinational e-commerce company headquartered in Ottawa, Ontario, that operates a cloud e-commerce management platform (CEMP) for retail point-of-sale systems. The company has over five million customers and processed US$292.3 billion in transactions in 2024, of which 57% was in the United States. Major customers include Tesla, LVMH, Nestlé, PepsiCo, AB InBev, Kraft Heinz, Lindt, Whole Foods Market, Red Bull, and Hyatt. [...] The company's software has been praised for its ease of use and reasonable fee structure. It has been described as the "go-to e-commerce platform for startups".

He was also candid that "the volume from agentic commerce is still small relative to our massive GMV," as Digital Commerce 360 reported. [...] 6,204: Shopify's net gain in stores from rival platforms over the 90 days to October 23, 2026, per Store Leads. Shopify signed Mulberry, Balmain and LVMH in Q1 2026, executives said on the Q1 call. The counter-trend is real too, with GM and Quince moving to custom builds.

### B2B commerce moves down-market [...] In the 90 days to October 23, 2026, Store Leads saw 28,126 stores move to Shopify and 21,922 leave, a net gain of 6,204. WooCommerce was the largest source (9,563) and custom-built carts the largest destination (9,422).

Recent arrivals include Barnes & Noble from Oracle Commerce and Canada Goose from Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Recent departures include General Motors and Quince, both to custom builds.
